# Hardware Assembly Log

This is the hardware workstream of the broader Cerberus platform project.

| Component | Status | Evidence / notes |
|---|---|---|
| MUSETEX K2 | **Owned — arrived** | Inspect chassis and retain included hardware |
| MSI MAG B850 Tomahawk MAX WiFi | **Owned — arrived** | Add sanitized photo when available |

## Before assembly

- [ ] Keep the motherboard in its anti-static packaging until bench work.
- [ ] Retain the manual, Wi-Fi antenna, SATA cables, M.2 hardware, screws, bags, and accessories.
- [ ] Inspect the AM5 socket, board, case, glass, connectors, and included fans.
- [ ] Confirm radiator, GPU, M.2, and PCIe plans.
- [ ] Prepare verified BIOS and Fedora media on separate labelled USB drives.
- [ ] Record components without publishing serial numbers.
